北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京风大天冷，记得多穿衣，注意保暖防风哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is windy and cold, remember to dress warmly and protect against the wind!
北京.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃ | 💨 北风警报：西北风 6级

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波小雨绵绵，湿度很高，注意保持干燥。
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Ningbo has continuous light rain and high humidity, remember to stay dry.
宁波.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海天阴，注意添衣，别让凉意侵扰哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy, remember to add layers to avoid the chill.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州温暖湿润，注意通风，保持舒爽心情。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is warm and humid, ensure good ventilation to stay comfortable.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云暖和，湿度较大，注意多饮水哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy and warm with high humidity, remember to drink more water.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州有雾，能见度低，驾车出行请小心慢行！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is foggy, visibility is low, please drive carefully!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，气温适中，早晚出门记得添衣。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy with moderate temperatures, remember to add layers in the morning and evening.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都湿度大，天气阴沉，保持心情好哟！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is humid and cloudy, keep a good mood!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有雾，能见度不高，出行多注意安全。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is foggy with low visibility, please be extra careful when traveling.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗宜人，适合户外活动，注意防晒。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and pleasant, suitable for outdoor activities, remember sun protection.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有雾，能见度低，外出注意交通安全。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is foggy with low visibility, please be careful when commuting.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨天寒地冻，务必穿暖和，小心着凉！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is freezing cold, be sure to dress warmly to avoid catching a cold!
哈尔滨.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳风大天冷，保暖防风是重点，注意温差。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is windy and cold, keeping warm and windproof is key, mind the temperature difference.
沈阳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，气温舒适，记得带件外套以防温差。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy with comfortable temperatures, bring a jacket for temperature changes.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阳光正好，体感舒适，尽情享受美景吧！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is perfectly sunny and comfortable, enjoy the beautiful scenery!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛风力强劲，体感偏冷，出门多加件衣服哦！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao has strong winds and feels colder, put on an extra layer when going out!
青岛.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 6级

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连气温偏低，多云，注意保暖，别着凉。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian's temperature is a bit low and cloudy, remember to keep warm and don't catch a cold.

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦多云暖和，适合户外，但别忘了防晒哦。
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Zhangpu is cloudy and warm, good for outdoors, but don't forget sun protection.

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪有小雨，出门别忘带伞，小心路滑哟！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has light rain, don't forget your umbrella, and watch for slippery roads!
